subject: Evorex onboarding — evidence access checklist and follow-up
messages:
From: Asha Bhandari <asha.bhandari@evorex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <m.reed@evorex.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding evidence & Art. 28/30 outputs — initial ask

Hi Marissa / Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As part of our Legal & Privacy intake we need a concise set of materials to land internal approvals:

- Short statement of where processing occurs (regions / subprocessors) and any onshore guarantees.
- Sample Art. 30 processing register excerpt (we only need an extract for the integrations you will use).
- KMS wrap / key management excerpts (sample logs ok) to show tenant separation and rotation cadence.
- A candidate DPA addendum we can circulate to our procurement team (they prefer redlines rather than word docs).

Can you deliver a put-together checklist + attachments by EOD Thursday (our legal sprint is Friday)? If you need us to accept any standard audit steps or a stub for remote evidence access, say so and we can coordinate with our InfoSec.

Also copying Marcus — he’s the security reviewer for integrations.

Best,
Asha

--
Asha Bhandari
Head of Privacy Operations, Evorex Health
asha.bhandari@evorex.com
+44 20 5555 0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Bhandari <asha.bhandari@evorex.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & Art. 28/30 outputs — initial ask

Thanks Asha — great to meet you earlier. We can definitely assemble the items you listed. Quick summary of what I’ll include and the approach: 

1) Regions & processing map: short paragraph + an exportable CSV extract (Art.30-style) with fields you commonly request (processing purpose, categories, subprocessors, legal basis, data flows).

2) Art.30 sample: attach a 1-page CSV extract showing the pipeline for the integration (will redact internal-only IDs).

3) KMS/key management: provide a logs excerpt (time-limited sample) plus a short note on key rotation, tenant separation, and HSM usage.

4) DPA addendum: I’ll attach a draft PDF (track changes redline) that covers audit rights, access windows, and an agreed remote evidence access procedure. We are open to a short DocuSign for acceptance.

Attachments I’m sending in this thread (zipped for size): redwood_art30_sample.csv, kms-logs-excerpt.txt, dpa-addendum-draft.pdf.

One ask from your side — does your procurement need on-prem inspection windows (we can offer 2 business days notice + limited sampling), or will remote evidence suffice for this onboarding? If remote is OK we’ll include a runbook for evidence extraction and the API endpoints we’ll enable for the inspection.

Plan: I’ll send the packet by EOD today so you have time for internal review before Friday. Priyom — let me know if you want to add any operational caveats (retention sampling, scope limits).

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Enterprise Privacy & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0199

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Asha Bhandari <asha.bhandari@evorex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 13:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & Art. 28/30 outputs — initial ask

Asha — quick clarifications from the operations side: 

- Remote evidence: we support read-only export packages via a time-limited bundle (S3 link with 72h expiry) and can provide a subset of raw logs for sampling. That is typically sufficient for most privacy inspections.
- Onsite checks: we can schedule an onsite/recorded session but need 10 business days lead time for environment snapshots and an appropriate NDA/amendment (we've included that language in the DPA addendum).
- Subprocessors: the CSV will include the subprocessor list with country; note we have two optional cloud partners that may be EU/US based but can be pinned to EU-only routes for your tenant under Dedicated or Private.

Action items I’ll complete today: attach the CSV extract, include a short runbook for initiating an evidence bundle, and provide a sample HubSpot audit ticket template your team can use to request access. I’ll also drop a DocuSign link for the DPA addendum if you indicate remote-only is acceptable.

Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Director, Trust & Ops
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Marcus Reed <m.reed@evorex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Bhandari <asha.bhandari@evorex.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & Art. 28/30 outputs — initial ask

Marissa / Priyom — this looks good. Remote evidence is fine for our initial review, provided the CSV & KMS samples are time-bound and include a short statement of sampling methodology. We also want the DPA addendum with an explicit audit-window clause (we typically ask for 30 days' notice for remote bundles).

Please proceed to share the Drive folder and DocuSign link; we’ll aim to sign and run our sprint Friday.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Reed
Security Reviewer, Evorex Health
m.reed@evorex.com
Attachments in thread: redwood_art30_sample.csv (CSV excerpt, 3 rows), kms-logs-excerpt.txt (text excerpt, redacted), dpa-addendum-draft.pdf (PDF with redlines).
